entities.summary: David Douglas Crosby is a Canadian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He was the ninth Bishop of Hamilton from 2010 to 2025, having previously served as Bishop of St. George’s Corner Brook, Newfoundland and Labrador (2003–2007) and Bishop of Corner Brook and Labrador (2007–2010).
